title: 🤯 "Tell me about it" DOESN'T Mean What You Think! #Shorts #EnglishLearning

subtitles.en: Ugh, Monday morning traffic was an absolute nightmare today.
subtitles.zh: 呃，今天週一早上的交通根本是場惡夢。

subtitles.en: So it all started with this red sedan.
subtitles.zh: 事情是從一輛紅色轎車開始的……

subtitles.en: I don't actually want to hear the story.
subtitles.zh: 我其實沒有真的想聽故事啦。

subtitles.en: Wait, but literally tell me means share details.
subtitles.zh: 等等，但字面上 tell me 不就是叫我分享細節嗎？

subtitles.en: In real life, native speakers never mean that.
subtitles.zh: 在現實生活中，母語人士根本不是那個意思。

subtitles.en: It actually means, I totally agree or I feel your pain.
subtitles.zh: 它其實是指「我超認同」或是「我懂你的痛」。

subtitles.en: Ah, so it is pure empathy, not curiosity.
subtitles.zh: 啊，所以純粹是同理心，而不是真的八卦好奇喔！

subtitles.en: So when someone vents about something awful, you say?
subtitles.zh: 所以當有人在抱怨很衰的事時，你要說……？
